name: LSMA
description: This keyword returns the Least Square Moving Average of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Least Square Moving Average of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632222983.png)

You can plot LSMA on any series, like High in the above example, you can also plot LSMA of RSI, OPEN etc
